vibe_rationale: Small, welcoming community wellness day run by a mental-health non-profit, but thin on culture programming and not a subculture core.
fit_notes: Yoga and wellness crowd with clear health adjacency (age not published), and a mental-health non-profit host makes this a values-aligned, low-cost partnership. Free entry with volunteer roles and workshops, but no sponsors or attendance are published. Okinawa-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
